name: useAltimeter
summary: Precision barometric altimetry, vertical climb/descent velocity, and weather trends.
plain: Computes real-time altitude from the hardware barometer using the international ICAO hypsometric atmosphere formula. Provides vertical climb velocity in m/s, storm pressure trend detection, and custom sea-level reference calibration (QNH).
description: Derived from the physical air pressure sensor via expo-sensors. Computes altitude above calibrated sea level using the standard barometric formula: h = 44330 * (1 - (P / P0)^0.1903). Automatically computes vertical velocity (rate of climb/descent in m/s) with exponential smoothing, categorizes atmospheric pressure trends (rising, steady, falling, rapid_fall), and supports local QNH calibration.

params.name: updateIntervalMs
params.desc: Sampling period in milliseconds for the barometer, defaulting to 100ms.

returns.name: altitudeM
returns.desc: Current barometric altitude in meters above calibrated sea level. Null until first sample.

returns.name: altitudeFt
returns.desc: Current barometric altitude in feet above calibrated sea level. Null until first sample.

returns.name: verticalVelocityMs
returns.desc: Rate of climb or descent in meters per second (m/s), smoothed over recent samples. Null until moving.

returns.name: pressureHpa
returns.desc: Raw atmospheric pressure in hectopascals (hPa / mbar).

returns.name: seaLevelPressureHpa
returns.desc: Calibrated reference sea-level pressure in hPa. Defaults to standard 1013.25.

returns.name: pressureTrend
returns.desc: Short-term pressure change trend indicating weather changes (rapid_fall indicates storm front).

returns.name: isAvailable
returns.desc: Whether the hardware barometer is present and streaming.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if sensor access or subscription failed.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Data provenance: 'derived' from hardware barometer, or 'unavailable'.

returns.name: calibrateSeaLevel
returns.desc: Calibrates reference sea-level pressure (QNH) to zero out local elevation.

returns.name: resetCalibration
returns.desc: Resets sea-level reference pressure back to standard 1013.25 hPa.

actions.name: calibrateSeaLevel(hPa)
actions.desc: Sets the baseline sea-level pressure (QNH) in hPa.

actions.name: resetCalibration()
actions.desc: Resets sea-level pressure back to standard atmosphere (1013.25 hPa).

agentNote: Barometric altimetry reflects atmospheric pressure and drifts with weather fronts; use calibrateSeaLevel with local METAR/QNH for absolute altitude.
